quote: "Quality minus junk" is a factor that measures the performance of a basket of growing profitable companies, pitted against unprofitable stagnant companies. Over the last 12months "quality minus junk" is down 28% peak to trough. This is statistically extreme and worse than 99% of historical windows. Why does this matter? We are in a unique period in markets that mathematically cannot be sustained. In this environment we are careful to focus on our assessment of long term, future returns for our portfolio companies and not recent share price movements.
